title: Bilinear formalism for Schwarzian KP and Harry Dym hierarchies
summary: We consider the Schwarzian KP and Harry Dym hierarchies in the framework of the bilinear formalism which is well known for such integrable hierarchies as KP, modified KP, BKP, Toda lattice and other. We show that, similarly to the bilinear formulation of the modified KP hierarchy, the Schwarzian KP can be reformulated as an integral bilinear equation for a pair of KP tau-functions with the property that any linear combination of them is again a tau function of the KP hierarchy.
